spanish: y vino acercarás a la libación, mitad del hin: ofrenda de fuego, olor de reposo a Jehová.

findings.issue: «la» marks the libation as definite; the token is a preposition plus an absolute noun and the morphology does not include the article.

notes: Order, 2ms hiphil, measure, construct chain, and Jehová stay inside the packet.
